note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Unlike the sibling nuclear-medicine-test-request engine, a high radiationDoseBand here does NOT lift the prepSafetyBand to caution — the two are fully independent, so even the well-formed persona below carries a (non-blocking) high-dose flag.

personas.name: routine-lymphoma-fdg-pet-ct-well-controlled-glucose-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine referral: biopsy-confirmed lymphoma, FDG-PET-CT is the recommended (ideal) study for the lymphoma indication, blood glucose is well-controlled (5.5 mmol/L, below even the EANM-preferred 7 mmol/L threshold), no pregnancy/breastfeeding concerns, every completeness field including the IR(ME)R justification present — expect usually-appropriate + ok prep safety + high dose (flagged but non-blocking) + routine + accept.

triage.notes: Haematology MDT discussion planned once staged.

personas.name: query-referrer-cancer-staging-fdg-pet-ct-uncontrolled-glucose-caution
personas.description: Newly diagnosed lung cancer with poorly-controlled diabetes: FDG-PET-CT is the recommended (ideal) study for the cancer-staging indication, but a blood glucose of 14.2 mmol/L is above the ~11 mmol/L uncontrolled threshold — FDG uptake will be impaired — forcing the prep-safety band to caution, which alone is enough to force query-referrer in this engine (unlike the sibling nuclear-medicine engine, caution here is not relabelled as an 'accept with caution'); urgency was explicitly requested as urgent — expect usually-appropriate + caution prep safety + high dose + urgent + query-referrer.

personas.name: reject-solitary-pulmonary-nodule-fdg-pet-ct-pregnant-incomplete
personas.description: An incidental solitary pulmonary nodule in a patient confirmed 8 weeks pregnant: FDG-PET-CT is the recommended (ideal) study for the solitary-pulmonary-nodule indication — there is no appropriateness mismatch here — but confirmed pregnancy is contraindicated for PET-CT radiation exposure, forcing this engine's `reject` recommendation ahead of any appropriateness or completeness check; blood glucose was also never recorded for this FDG study, and several other administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + contraindicated prep safety + high dose + routine + reject, completeness below 100.

context.relevantHistory: Incidental 2.2cm solitary pulmonary nodule on CT. Currently 8 weeks pregnant, confirmed by urine hCG.
